# ttvl.co

> Personal website of Toto Tvalavadze featuring photography documentation, notebook system templates, personal notes, and various creative projects.

This site serves as a digital garden and documentation hub for various personal and creative projects, with a strong focus on analog photography, notebook systems, and thoughtful writing. The site includes a search function accessible via the '?' key.

## Photography & Darkroom

- [Darkroom](/darkroom/): Technical documentation and guides for analog photography.
  - [Film Identification Format](/darkroom/roll-id/): Guide for identifying and tracking film rolls.
  - [Travel Film Development Kit](/darkroom/travel-dev-kit): Portable darkroom setup.
  - [Bulk Film Canister Stickers](/darkroom/canister-stickers): DIY film canister labeling system.
  - [Valoi Easy120 with Negative Supply Light](/darkroom/valoi-easy120-with-negative-supply-99cri-light): A 3D-printable adapter that marries two popular systems for film scanning into a single system that produces good colors.
  - [Thermometer Panel for JOBO Systems](/darkroom/thermometer-panel-for-jobo-systems): 3D-printed temperature monitoring panel for accurate color development.

## Notebook System

- [Unbound Notebook System](/notebook-system/), or UNS: Framework for hybrid digital and analog note-taking system that Toto developed and is using.
  - [Analog Photography Templates](/notebook-system/analog-photography-templates/): Templates for film photography workflow.
  - [General Templates](/notebook-system/general-templates/): Basic notebook templates.
  - [Make Your Own](/notebook-system/make-your-own/): Guide to creating custom UNS notebook.

## Projects

- [Project Humane](/project-humane/): Tools and toys Toto makes for productivity and work.
  - [EDC Keychain](/project-humane/edc-keychain/): Everyday carry system to carry daily essentials that do not fit into men's pant pockets.
  - [Whoopy CLI](/project-humane/whoopy/): Unofficial WHOOP data CLI for the terminal, automation, and AI agents.
  - [Withingy CLI](/project-humane/withingy/): Withings data CLI for the terminal with activity, sleep, and workout support.
  - [Soma](/project-humane/soma/): A macOS app (work in progress) to scan loose leafs and transcribe them into text documents.

## 8-String Guitar Studies

- [8-String Guitar Studies](/8-strings/): Notes on relearning guitar from scratch on an 8-string instrument for metal, jazz, extended-range tuning, fretboard mapping, muting, and practice systems.
  - [How to Tune an 8-String Guitar](/8-strings/how-to-tune-an-8-string-guitar/): Practical tuning setup for standard F# tuning, Drop E, and slightly flat low-string offsets.

## Notes

- [Notes](/notes/): Essays, resources, and working notes.
  - [Where I Stand on AI](/notes/where-i-stand-on-ai): Personal perspective on artificial intelligence.
  - [Soviet, Not Russia](/notes/soviet-not-russia): Cultural and historical observations.
  - [Non-Photographers Need Not Apply](/notes/non-photographers-need-not-apply): Thoughts on photography culture.
  - [Ten Rules for Students and Teachers](/notes/ten-rules-for-students-and-teachers): Educational philosophy.
  - [Walking](/notes/walking): Notes on walking as a practice.

## Flaneur

- [Flaneur](/flaneur/): Photography newsletter featuring curated images and stories.
  - Episodes 001-012 available, including recent editions featuring urban exploration and architectural photography.

## Log

- [Log](/log/): Monthly journal entries documenting projects and activities.
  - Backfilled entries from 2020-2022
  - Current entries through August 2025
